user.title: Connect the projector
user.description: Use the projector's network address and debugging port. Screen, brightness, and luminance boost are read from the projector, so the remote and the picture menu stay in sync.

authorize.title: Allow debugging on the projector
authorize.description: The projector is showing Allow USB debugging. Choose Allow, and check Always allow from this computer. The picture has to be on to see that prompt. Then continue here.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the projector. Check the address and that network debugging is turned on.
error.not_authorized: The projector has not allowed this connection yet.
error.not_xgimi: This device did not answer the XGIMI screen command.

abort.already_configured: This projector is already set up.
abort.wrong_device: That address is a different projector.
